content: पृ I. €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> (प्रियते-पृत) To be busy or active (mostly with व्या); कार्ये व्याप्रियते; see व्यापृत. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (पारयति-ते) .²1 To cause to work, engage upon, entrust, with, appoint to; (usually with <ab>loc.</ab>); व्यापारितः शूलमृता विधाय सिंहत्वमङ्कागतसत्त्ववृत्ति <ls>R. 2. 38</ls>. .²2 To place, set, fix, direct, cast; व्यापारयामास करं किरीटे <ls>R. 6. 19</ls>; उमामुखे … व्यापारयामास विलोचनानि <ls>Ku. 3. 67</ls>; व्यापारितं शिरसि शस्त्रमशस्त्रपाणेः <ls>Ve. 3. 19</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 25</ls>. --II. €3 <ab>P.</ab> (पिपर्ति, पूर्ण) .²1 To bring or carry over. .²2 To deliver from, bring out of. .²3 To fill. .²4 To protect, maintain, sustain. .²5 To promote, advance. --III. €9 <ab>P.</ab> (पृणाति) To protect. --IV. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (पारयति-ते; sometimes पार् is regarded as a separate root.) .²1 To carry over or across, ferry over. .²2 To reach the other side of anything, accomplish, perform, achieve, bring to a conclusion (a vow <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 To be able or capable; न खलु मातापितरौ भर्तृवियोगदुःखितां दुहितरं द्रष्टुं पारयतः <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; न पारयामि तातकाश्यपस्य … आपन्नसत्त्वां शकुन्तलां निवेदयितुम् <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; अधिकं न हि पारयामि वक्तुम् <ls>Bv. 2. 59</ls>. .²4 To deliver, save, extricate, rescue. .²5 To withstand, oppose. .²6 To live. --V. €5 <ab>P.</ab> (पृणोति) .²1 To please or delight, gratify. .²2 To be pleased or delighted.
